column1: # Words the HSK 1 list prints with a northern 儿 ending (erhua). Used by the "儿 endings" switch.
# columns: official form, plain form, official pinyin, plain pinyin, twin
#   twin = yes: the plain form is ALSO its own word on the official list, so in plain mode the 儿 word is dropped, not renamed.
#   twin = no : the plain form is not on the list; in plain mode the word is renamed (its progress is carried over).
# 儿子 and 女儿 are NOT here: in those words 儿 means "child" and is part of the word.
